name: Arcane Critical (Su)
body:
Benefit: Whenever the magus scores a critical hit, he earns a single temporary point he may add to his arcane pool. If this point is not used by the end of the magus’s next round, it is lost.

Special: The magus may use this ability once per day for every 4 levels (minimum 1/day).
